summary: Perspective Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 8, 2026, disclosing an updated corporate presentation furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The presentation highlights three clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical programs, including VMT-α-NET, VMT01 and PSV359, and cites a $45 billion-plus addressable market. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural or regulatory mechanics are stated. The filing contains no special-situation event; it is an ordinary investor-presentation update. Risk-arb angle: none, as no deal terms or overhang are present.
